## Showcase submission

- [ ] One entry folder only; folder and slug match.
- [ ] model.yaml is complete and event matches its parent folder.
- [ ] Model link is public and contains the model card.
- [ ] Demo is public (required for hackathon entries).
- [ ] No model weights or files over 5 MB.
- [ ] I ran the exported model locally and stated the hardware.
- [ ] Before/after outputs are real and use the same held-out prompt.
- [ ] I have the right to share the data and model.
